Task:
A two-agent team must finalize a bugfix delivery note. Agent A defines done as "unit tests pass". Agent B defines done as "unit tests pass and regression checklist reviewed". Produce one unified completion decision and rationale.
Return a concise answer and indicate when the task is complete.

**Unified Completion Decision:** The bugfix delivery note is considered complete when both unit tests pass and the regression checklist has been reviewed.

**Rationale:** Agent A's definition of "done" focuses on the functionality of the code, ensuring that the bugfix does not introduce new issues. Agent B's definition adds an additional layer of assurance by requiring a review of the regression checklist, which ensures that existing functionalities remain unaffected. To meet both agents' criteria, the task will be complete only when both conditions are satisfied.

**Task Status:** Task is complete.
